scripts.build:all: npm run build:launcher && npm run build:ide && npm run build:notes && npm run build:assistant && npm run build:combine
scripts.build:combine: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp -r apps/launcher/dist/* dist/ && mkdir -p dist/ide dist/notes dist/assistant && cp -r apps/ide/dist/* dist/ide/ && cp -r apps/notes/dist/* dist/notes/ && cp -r apps/assistant/dist/* dist/assistant/
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd apps/launcher && npm install && cd ../ide && npm install && cd ../notes && npm install && cd ../assistant && npm install
